name: ai-chat
description: AI Chat - Next.js SSR Frontend + FastAPI Backend

scripts.dev: npm run _check-node && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source .venv/bin/activate && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 --reload
scripts.build: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm run build
scripts.build:preview: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm run build:preview
scripts.lint: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm run lint:fix
scripts.format: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm run format
scripts.type-check: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm run type-check
scripts.install:all: npm run _check-node && npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && pip install -e .
scripts.install:frontend: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.test:frontend: npm run _check-node && cd frontend && npm test
